text: This collection brings together Charlie Munger's speeches and reflections on investing, judgment, learning, and life. Alongside a biographical portrait, it presents his approach to drawing useful ideas from many disciplines and combining them into a practical way of thinking. Eleven talks explore business, economics, philanthropy, and human psychology, with an emphasis on intellectual curiosity, ethical conduct, and recognizing the mental habits that produce poor decisions.
author: Charles T. Munger; edited by Peter D. Kaufman
